metadata.title: Principal bundles in supersymmetry
metadata.abstract: We discuss rather basic problems on super principal bundles for $C^{\infty}$-supermanifolds (over $\mathbb{R}$) and analytic supermanifolds over a complete field of arbitrary characteristic. Sharper answers are obtained for $C^{\infty}$-supermanifolds and for homogeneous supermanifolds. Among others, it is proved for $C^{\infty}$-supermanifolds that given a $C^{\infty}$-supermanifold $B$ and a super Lie group $G$, there is a natural one-to-one correspondence (up to isomorphism) between the $G$-super principal bundles over $B$ and the $G_{\mathrm{rd}}$-principal bundles over $B_{\mathrm{rd}}$, where $G_{\mathrm{rd}}$ (resp., $B_{\mathrm{rd}}$) denotes the ordinary Lie group (resp., manifold) associated with $G$ (resp., $B$). To prove this, we show a generalized, equivariant version of the renowned Batchelor Theorem.

analysis.workSummary: 研究光滑及解析超流形上的超主丛，证明 C∞ 范畴下 G 超主丛同构类与约化底空间上的普通 G_rd 主丛自然一一对应。
analysis.breakthrough: 将光滑超主丛的分类还原为普通主丛问题。
analysis.limitations: 光滑结论不能直接搬到任意特征解析范畴；摘要另列的解析问题有不同答案。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 对超几何和主丛基础研究实用，但专业门槛较高。
